# Jeremiah Ajayi

> Marketing consultant for B2B SaaS and technology companies, based in Lagos, Nigeria. Three services: positioning and messaging, product launches and go-to-market, and content and organic growth. Works with teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa. Also co-founder and Executive Director of EmpowerQ, a nonprofit for the economic inclusion of LGBTQ+ professionals in Nigeria.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.thejeremiahajayi.com/services/): who it's for, engagement models and how pricing is scoped
- [Positioning and messaging](https://www.thejeremiahajayi.com/services/positioning-messaging/): customer research, positioning, messaging frameworks, website and sales copy
- [Product launch and GTM](https://www.thejeremiahajayi.com/services/product-launch-gtm/): GTM briefs, launch plans, sales enablement, launch-to-pipeline measurement; 20+ launches led
- [Content and organic growth](https://www.thejeremiahajayi.com/services/content-growth/): content strategy, SEO and AI search visibility; 174% organic growth at RemotePass

## Proof

- [Work](https://www.thejeremiahajayi.com/work/): Stears Elections (#1 on Google above the BBC), RemotePass × Certn (270+ media pickups), RemotePass content ($500K+ pipeline in under a year), Xofu repositioning; $3M+ pipeline influenced overall
- [What I’d Do](https://www.thejeremiahajayi.com/what-id-do/): a free newsletter and monthly live event series about solving marketing problems
- [Blog](https://www.thejeremiahajayi.com/blog/): articles on marketing, product launches, content and AI search
- [Writing](https://www.thejeremiahajayi.com/writing/): AI search research, including The State of AI Search in Nigeria and four Foundation Labs studies
